scope: Local shared keyloop-inventory-local database; no production deployment
concurrency: READ COMMITTED; sorted union of old/new technician users, then sorted service bays FOR UPDATE; fresh selected-pair availability recheck; bounded transaction retry; conditional booking versions retained
compatibility: Hourly service/start rules and derived in-memory bitmap remain; no GiST index or new dependency
limitations: All booking writers must follow application locking protocol; direct SQL writes bypass it
Writes sharing a technician or bay serialize across hours and dates
Downgrade requires stopped writers and verified source/backup or deliberate claim re-backfill
backupRestore: Full and application archives retained privately. Application archive restored into isolated PostgreSQL, all original public table counts/hashes matched, migration rehearsed. Ownership/ACL restoration omitted; current privacy checked separately. Full Supabase platform disaster recovery not tested.
checks: Focused code review, cross-midnight finding fixed and re-reviewed
Historical migrations compared against private source snapshot
regressionsCovered: Opposing reschedules lock old/new resource union
Stale concurrent edits and racing create/reschedule
Cross-midnight legacy overlap, adjacency and cancellation

Racing reschedule and create cannot share destination
